headline: Watches under $2,700 (stopped)
stop_reason: Only 4 watches in the $1,450–$2,650 band have a clean cut-out photo and a verified price: Timex TW6A07200 ($1,450, timex.com, 21 Nov 2026), Oris 01 733 7810 4051 ($2,200, Watches of Switzerland, 22 Nov 2026), Oris 01 733 7810 4055 07 6 ($2,200, Oris library, 22 Nov 2026), Longines L2.949.4.73.6 ($2,650, Exquisite Timepieces, 22 Nov 2026). A listicle needs 6 qualifying watches for the 8-slide minimum. Rejected: Oris 01 733 7721 photo file is an HTML error page, not an image; Hamilton H32755851 photo is a dial close-up, not a cut-out; Tissot T932.408 photo has a grey background smear; Tissot T932.207 has a shadow (lesson). Two of the four are Oris variants of one model family. No new listicle was drafted. Next step: add a few more verified watches with clean photos in one band, then rerun.
